implementation: Original JavaScript connected single-cup growth benchmark; not a Houdini cook or completed reproduction of the complex reference colony
scope: Growth only; no sand, grains, bubbles, purchased HIP, teacher movie or teacher geometry
algorithm: Connected pointed cup seed with circumference-dependent sampling; no separate fixed cylinder or preplaced leaf membranes
Curvature, normal-to-light direction and projected self-occlusion masks
Conforming long-edge splitting with shared midpoints
Deterministic stored snapshots of genuinely computed geometry
Two-level Loop subdivision for displayed tissue surface; raw solver topology and OBJ remain inspectable
Edge-activated anisotropic rest-metric growth with bounded local strain
Angular chart preservation and projected triangle orientation guard in the single-body safe domain
A 0.004-unit closed offset shell with joined rim represents tissue thickness for rendering; raw solver stays a membrane
